Commentary: Ravi Bishnoi to Rashid Khan, out Bowled!! 2nd wicket for Bishnoi, well tossed up leg break on middle, Khan kneels down and goes for the slog sweep, connects only thin air and the ball goes past the outside edge to crash into the stumps, India are one wicket away from a clean sweep. Rashid Khan b Ravi Bishnoi 6(5) [4s-1]
Ravi Bishnoi to Fazalhaq Farooqi, no run, quicker delivery mighty closer to the off-stump, Farooqi goes for a loose drive and misses it
Nitish Reddy to Abdullah Ahmadzai, no run, back of a length and outside off, Ahmadzai smashes it to long on, he didn't take the single
Nitish Reddy to Abdullah Ahmadzai, no run, fuller length delivery on off, Ahmadzai drives it to wide long off
Nitish Reddy to Abdullah Ahmadzai, FOUR, smashed down the ground, pitched up and in the slot, Ahmadzai gets under the ball nicely and drills it to long-off, one bounce over the ropes
Nitish Reddy to Abdullah Ahmadzai, no run, slower delivery on the stumps, Ahmadzai goes for a wild swing and misses it
Nitish Reddy to Abdullah Ahmadzai, 1 run, yorker length delivery on middle, Ahmadzai clips it to mid-wicket
Nitish Reddy to Fazalhaq Farooqi, no run, slips in another yorker on target, Farooqi digs it out to covers

Ravi Bishnoi to Abdullah Ahmadzai, out Caught by Axar Patel!! It's all over, a clean sweep for India, well tossed up on off, Ahmadzai goes for a wild slog across the line and miscues it high in the air towards deep midwicket, where Axar takes a well judged catch moving to his left. Abdullah Ahmadzai c Axar Patel b Ravi Bishnoi 6(8) [4s-1]
